leadText:
Jules (Japanese: ジョーズ Jaws) is a character of the day who appeared in An Epic Defense Force!.

He is a movie director and a rival of Luke, but he also acts in his own movies. Jules approached and Luke after overhearing Luke's movie script for the Pokéstar Studios Film Competition. He was quick to criticize the script for being bad, and proved overly arrogant throughout his appearance. He has known Luke for a while because they have both competed in a number of film festivals.

Jules was quite confident about the movie he made, but the prize for the Best Picture and chance to work with Mr. Gold went to Luke, which upset Jules.
